trust_decision.summary: The workspace path (which comes from the job name) is treated as trusted text. It is embedded, inside double quotes and unescaped, into the generated GIT_SSH shell script as the UserKnownHostsFile value, so shell metacharacters in the path such as $( ) run on the agent. The only guards are the per-character filters in createTempFile, which reject backquote and percent but not $(.

landing_point.why: The summary says OS command injection on agents. The existing 'Avoid backquote shell expansion' filter in createTempFile is the obvious place to look, and so is the GIT_SSH script writer createUnixGitSSH at :2713.

fix_sites.entry_point: GitClient credentialed remote ops (fetch_/clone_/push/getHeadRev/getRemoteReferences/submoduleUpdate/checkout LFS) -> launchCommandWithCredentials -> createTempFile
same credentialed remote ops with SSHUserPrivateKey credentials; known_hosts temp file moved to the system temp dir

fix_sites.module_kind: separate verifier package (host-key strategy, lower-level public API)

fix_sites.entry_point: escapePath, via getVerifyHostKeyOption; shell quoting of the path

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/main/java/org/jenkinsci/plugins/gitclient/verifier/ManuallyProvidedKeyVerifier.java:26-53 (public getVerifyHostKeyOption builds the shell fragment for any Path it is given; it lives in the verifier package, not in CliGitAPIImpl)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Once createTempFile rejects $( (or known_hosts moves to /tmp), no hostile path reaches the verifier any more, so a solver can argue its quoting is a host-key-verification feature and needs no change. Its 'escaping needed in case job name contains spaces' comment also makes it look deliberate.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Credential temp files (the key, passphrase and askpass) deliberately go in the per-workspace @tmp dir, not the shared system tmp. Workspaces whose names contain spaces, parentheses or single quotes (e.g. "Bob's-job", "My OWASP (special) case") must keep using it, and OpenSSH needs a path containing a space wrapped in double quotes inside the -o value. An over-broad fix that sends every temp file to system tmp, or rejects any path with special characters, breaks this.

O6_input_shapes: percent sign (ssh token expansion, pre-existing filter at CliGitAPIImpl.java:1992)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: forCliGit adds -o UserKnownHostsFile=<configured known_hosts path> without quoting, the same way ManuallyProvided does
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: SshHostKeyVerificationStrategy.KNOWN_HOSTS_DEFAULT is already referenced here. Passing it explicitly to ssh is a natural feature (a non-default HOME on agents), written by copying the ManuallyProvided string format.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: accept-new mode writes learned keys to a per-workspace known_hosts file and passes its path in the ssh -o option
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Keeping accepted keys isolated per job is a plausible hardening request; the tempKnownHosts parameter is already passed in and unused.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: createUnixGitSSH writes the key path directly (-i <path>) instead of reading it from $JENKINS_GIT_SSH_KEYFILE
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The Windows and Unix writers differ in style. Inlining the key path is a simplification a maintainer could make, and it would put another workspace-derived path into shell text.

O9_family: OS command injection (CWE-78): a workspace path from the job name is embedded unquoted in a generated shell wrapper (GIT_SSH)

services: OpenSSH client (only for end-to-end; unit tests on getVerifyHostKeyOption/createTempFile need neither)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add "$(" next to the backquote check in createTempFile (CliGitAPIImpl.java:2007) and stop, leaving the verifier's double-quote wrapping (and ${...} etc.) in place.

out_of_scope_notes: The Windows GIT_SSH .bat (CliGitAPIImpl.java:2693-2705) uses 'setlocal enabledelayedexpansion' and embeds the verifier output raw. The Windows createTempFile filter (:2001) does not reject '!' or '&'; after the fix known_hosts is in system tmp, so this was not pursued.
unverified: O1=12 counts call sites of launchCommandWithCredentials (CliGitAPIImpl.java:638,684,993,1213,1579,2942,3194,3746,3781,3806,3849,3899); the mapping to distinct public GitClient methods was not verified one by one. They are all WHERE-type routes of one concept and will fall together.

The published escapePath writes \' inside single quotes (fix.diff:67-71), which does not escape a quote in POSIX sh. Hidden tests copied from fix.diff:278-303 would assert this exact (arguably wrong) string and penalise a correct '\'' fix. Tests should be behavioural (run the generated script, or check that no command substitution happens), not string-equal.

Exploitability needs the ManuallyProvidedKeyVerifier strategy plus SSH private-key credentials plus a CLI git workspace; other verifiers (KnownHostsFileVerifier.java:28, AcceptFirstConnectionVerifier.java:16, NoHostKeyVerifier.java:24) never embed the path.
